integrity: Two enumerations, using induced-subgraph root recursion and labeled brooms, give identical 29616 tubings. Every one of 70 color-pattern representatives has a complete graph BFS, with exact eccentricity and farthest-vertex witness in the standalone certificate. All operations are integers and finite sets.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite classification of the combinatorial one-skeleton only for K_{4,4}; no general K_{p,q} diameter law or all-pairs distance formula is asserted. The exhaustive certificate relies on the standard correspondence of maximal tubings, flips, and graph-associahedron skeleton edges.
title: The complete eccentricity profile of the balanced \(K_{4,4}\) graph associahedron
